en_title: Hogwarts Legacy 2 Is Officially in the Works, Confirms Warner Bros.
cn_title: 华纳兄弟确认《霍格沃茨之遗》续作开发中
subtitle: 魔法还没结束
opus_summary: 华纳兄弟确认《霍格沃茨之遗》续作正在开发，前作销量已达4,000万份。HBO剧版《哈利·波特》将在今年圣诞节重启系列，续作或于2028年底前推出。

paragraphs.en: A sequel to Hogwarts Legacy is actively in development, according to Warner Bros.
paragraphs.cn: 据华纳兄弟透露，《霍格沃茨之遗》续作目前正在积极开发中。

paragraphs.en: The studio confirmed in a recent earnings report that a "second installment" for Hogwarts Legacy is in the works. No details were provided on what the game will look like or when it might release, but it appears to be a serious focus for the company going forward. In the earnings report, WB expected that titles like Hogwarts Legacy 2 will "meaningfully contribute" to its future revenue.
paragraphs.cn: 华纳兄弟在最近发布的财报中确认，《霍格沃茨之遗》的「第二部作品」正在制作中。报告没有透露这款游戏的具体面貌或可能的发售时间，但它似乎会成为公司未来的重点。华纳兄弟还在财报中预计，像《霍格沃茨之遗2》这样的作品将为公司未来营收「作出实质性贡献」。

paragraphs.en: "We expect games to more meaningfully contribute to segment profitability going forward as our pipeline expands, including the second installment of Hogwarts Legacy," says the report.
paragraphs.cn: 报告中写道：「随着我们的产品管线不断扩展，包括《霍格沃茨之遗》续作在内的游戏，未来将对业务板块盈利作出更显著的贡献。」

paragraphs.en: This shouldn't come as too big of a shock, though. Warner Bros. had previously stated that a Hogwarts Legacy successor was a big priority following the success of the first game. Hogwarts Legacy is among the best-selling games of all time, with 40 million copies sold. In 2023, it was the first non-Call of Duty or Rockstar Games title since 2009 to be the top seller of the year .
paragraphs.cn: 不过，这其实并不令人太过意外。华纳兄弟此前就曾表示，在首作取得成功后，《霍格沃茨之遗》续作是公司的重点项目。《霍格沃茨之遗》跻身史上最畅销游戏之列，销量达到4,000万份。2023年，它成为自2009年以来首款登上年度销量榜首、且并非《使命召唤》或Rockstar作品的游戏。

paragraphs.en: Harry Potter is also getting a major second wind at Warner Bros. as it prepares to re-launch the franchise with a TV adaptation on HBO this Christmas. The show is already moving forward on its second season , casting major stars like Nicholas Hoult . The series will almost certainly ignite new interest in the brand and do wonders for a Hogwarts Legacy sequel.
paragraphs.cn: 随着华纳兄弟准备在今年圣诞节通过HBO电视剧版重启这一系列，《哈利·波特》也将在华纳兄弟迎来强势复兴。该剧第二季已经在推进，正在为Nicholas Hoult等知名演员安排选角。这部剧几乎肯定会重新激发人们对这一品牌的兴趣，也会为《霍格沃茨之遗》续作带来巨大助力。

paragraphs.en: With the first game having released in 2023, it wouldn't be surprising if we see a sequel by late 2028, if not sooner. While there's certainly room to expand the map, a lot of the heavy lifting has already been done by designing Hogwarts and its surrounding areas. There are likely ways for the team to reuse these assets in order to get the game done faster. However, they may also be afforded more time and resources to really push the boundaries with the sequel, thanks to the absurd success of the first game.
paragraphs.cn: 前作于2023年发售，续作如果能在2028年底前推出，甚至更早面世，也不会令人意外。地图当然还有拓展空间，但霍格沃茨及其周边区域的设计已经完成了大量繁重工作。开发团队很可能可以复用这些资产，从而更快完成游戏。不过，由于首作取得了惊人的成功，团队也可能获得更多时间和资源，在续作中进一步拓展游戏边界。

paragraphs.en: Maybe if we're lucky, it will be a launch title for PS6, which is speculated to release in fall 2027. Only time will tell, but more wizarding adventures are certainly on the way.
paragraphs.cn: 如果运气好，续作或许会成为PS6的首发游戏；外界推测PS6将在2027年秋季发售。究竟如何只能交给时间揭晓，但更多魔法世界冒险确实已经在路上。
